ncei:5468097.narrative: This tornado formed approximately 8 miles north of Alice in Jim Wells County and entered Duval County, according to law enforcement reports and radar data, approximately 11 miles north of San Diego.  The tornado continued northwest for roughly another 2 miles before finally dissipating.  Damage with this tornado across Duval County was limited to trees and vegetation.  This tornado formed in the outer rainbands of Hurricane Emily.

ncei:5480206.title: Olson, Kansas
ncei:5480206.narrative: This tornado was moving north as it crossed from northwest Morris county into southwest Geary county at 240 PM, approximately 3 miles southwest of Olson. It dissipated 2 miles northwest of Olson and was on the ground for 5 miles in Geary county. The tornado was weakening as it crossed Geary county. It was rated F0 for its duration in Geary county. The total path length from Morris to Geary counties for this tornado was 20 miles.  The parent thunderstorm was a mini-supercell.

ncei:5391561.title: Harper, Kansas
ncei:5391561.narrative: Large tornado moved over open country before hitting a farmstead and shearing off the roof of a veterinarians clinic and the top floor of a two story home.

ncei:5399359.title: Scott City, Kansas
ncei:5399359.narrative: This tornado briefly had circulation on the ground but was a funnel for about five minutes.  There was no damage.

ncei:5412046.title: Normal, Illinois
ncei:5412046.narrative: A tornado briefly touched down in a field.  No damage or injuries were reported.

ncei:5422918.title: Retreat, Georgia
ncei:5422918.narrative: A weak tornado knocked down trees and large limbs and did damage to a roof.

ncei:5428828.title: Taylor, Texas
ncei:5428828.narrative: A member of the public spotted a small tornado as it dropped to the ground in open country just northwest of Taylor.  The tornado was small and short-lived and caused no known damage.  It was rated F0 on the Fujita Scale.

ncei:5329895.title: Britton, South Dakota
ncei:5329895.narrative: A tornado touched down briefly south of Britton.

ncei:5333889.title: Amherst, Ohio
ncei:5333889.narrative: The parent thunderstorm that spawned the tornado in Henrietta Township produced a second tornado north of Amherst.  This touchdown occurred near State Route 2 between State Route 58 and Terra Lane.  The tornado was on the ground for around 300 yards and had a damage path up to 50 yards in width.  No structural damage occurred, but several trees were toppled along the damage path.

ncei:5349237.title: Tabor, Alabama
ncei:5349237.narrative: A tornado touched down in a heavily wooded area near the top of the ridge that forms Lookout Mountain in northeast Etowah County.  The tornado was photographed by a person in southwest Cherokee County and observed by several people on the west side of the ridge.  Besides trees, no other damage occurred since it was in an extremely remote area.Beg: 34 08.438/85 52.998  End:  34 08.935/85 51.960

ncei:5351248.title: Janice, Mississippi
ncei:5351248.narrative: A weak tornado briefly touched down just west of Janice.  A few trees were blown down and an outbuilding was damaged.

ncei:5356239.title: Ware, Missouri
ncei:5356239.narrative: A small tornado occurred along Highway WW near the Franklin, Washington, and Jefferson County line. This brief tornado downed and mangled trees along a short path which was about 50 yards wide.

ncei:5358091.title: Beverly, Missouri
ncei:5358091.narrative: Tornado in Leavenworth county crossed the Missouri River into Platte county around Missouri Route 92, near its intersection with North Farley Road. F1 damage was noted and extended one and a half miles to the east, with a width around 50 yards. Two barns had major damage and there were 16 homes with minor damage. There was also tree and fence damage noted.

ncei:5359569.title: Plains, Kansas
ncei:5359569.narrative: This tornado took out numerous trees, pivot sprinklers and blew out windows in one structure.

ncei:5296582.title: Masterson, Texas
ncei:5296582.narrative: The tornado occurred over open country and no damage was reported. A couple of trees were reported to be knocked over along with downed powerlines. The tornado path length and width were estimated.

ncei:5300205.title: Bloom, Kansas
ncei:5300205.narrative: This tornado crossed slowly into northern Clark county.

ncei:5246521.title: Cedar Falls, Iowa
ncei:5246521.narrative: Brief touchdown on the edge of town.

ncei:5252491.title: Brighton, Colorado
ncei:5252491.narrative: A small tornado touched down but did no damage.

ncei:5254415.title: Quitaque, Texas
ncei:5254415.narrative: Storm spotters reported a (landspout) tornado in open country east-northeast of town.  The tornado was nearly stationary.

ncei:5260931.title: Salyersville, Kentucky
ncei:5260931.narrative: Numerous reports of a tornado were received.  Emergency management reported that the tornado scrapped the ridgetops as it traveled to the southeast.  No damage was reported.

ncei:5268207.title: Burkett, Texas
ncei:5268207.narrative: Storm chasers reported a tornado northwest of Burkett in northern Coleman County, causing several telephone lines to be cut.

ncei:5270239.title: Lusk, Missouri
ncei:5270239.narrative: A brief tornado with peak winds of 90 MPH damaged or destroyed five sheds. A trailer home was damaged, and a light pole and several tree limbs were downed.

ncei:5132160.title: Omega, Georgia
ncei:5132160.narrative: A strong tornado crossed U.S. Highway 319 from extreme northeast Colquitt County into extreme southwest Tift County, just south of Omega.  Twelve mobile homes and eight pre-fabricated homes were destroyed.  Numerous frame homes were damaged, including some moved off their block foundations. Ten persons were injured. Numerous trees and power lines were down.  Just northeast of Omega, a school bus was blown into a nearby home.  Tift County was declared a federal disaster area.  Reported by the Tift County EMA.

ncei:5140353.title: Linden, Texas
ncei:5140353.narrative: This tornado developed in a high precipitation supercell as it moved eastward across the county.  This was one of several tornadoes that occured.  The tornado tracked eastward across wooded territory and farmland.  Several barns and 2 cross country electrical towers were toppled.

ncei:5163099.title: Mc Clave, Colorado
ncei:5163099.narrative: The supercell cycled another weak tornado northeast of McClave over open country.  Because of the lack of trees, crops, fence line, and roads, the exact path of the tornado was difficult to determine, and there was no damage discovered.

ncei:5178380.title: Meridian, Mississippi
ncei:5178380.narrative: An F2 tornado caused major damage in the Marion and Dalewood Shore Lake communities, northeast of Meridian. Two houses and thirteen mobile homes were destroyed. Eleven houses and twelve mobile homes received major damage. Thirty-three houses and twenty-two mobile homes received minor damage. Three businesses were destroyed and one business had minor damage. Thousands of trees were blown down or snapped off, and numerous power poles and power lines were also downed. Seventeen people were injured, including one in critical condition.

ncei:5681689.title: Koran, Louisiana
ncei:5681689.narrative: Tornado formed along a squall line notch, in the comma head.  Damage path consisted of moderate damage to two homes were trees penetrated the roof.  One mobile home completely destroyed.  Numerous snapped and fallen trees of three to four feet in diameter.  This tornado continued into Webster Parish, Louisiana.

ncei:5686925.title: Seneca, Kansas
ncei:5686925.narrative: A small tornado struck near Seneca and damaged a few farm homes and out buildings. One person was injured.

ncei:5712376.title: Onida, South Dakota
ncei:5712376.narrative: A tornado touched down briefly on a farm southeast of Onida.  Over half of the roof of a 40 by 45 foot building was torn off and deposited in a tree belt 200 yards to the north. The south wall of this building was caved in and the north wall was pulled out and the overhead door was ripped off.  A grain auger was also damaged when it was blown up against a granary. A semi trailer was blown over. About 400 acres of ripe wheat were also flattened and some sunflowers suffered damage as a result of the tornado. Path length and width were estimated.

ncei:5639770.title: Cape Coral, Florida
ncei:5639770.narrative: A short lived tornado touched down along Sanibel Captiva Road near Blind Pass on Sanibel Island and downed a few trees before it lifted and dissipated.

ncei:5647452.title: Etna Green, Indiana
ncei:5647452.narrative: THIS WAS ANOTHER TORNADO SPAWNED FROM THE SAME TORNADIC SUPERCELL THAT CAUSED DAMAGE IN PULASKI COUNTY EARLIER IN THE EVENING.  30 MOBILE HOMES AT THE MIKEL MOBILE ESTATES WERE DAMAGED, MANY SEVERELY.  SOME WERE SIMPLY OVERTURNED WHILE OTHERS WERE COMPLETELY FLATTENED.  4 PEOPLE SUSTAINED MINOR INJURIES.

ncei:5668056.title: El Reno, Oklahoma
ncei:5668056.narrative: A tornado touched down in open country. No damage was reported and the tornado was rated F0.

ncei:5673125.title: Hopewell, Florida
ncei:5673125.narrative: A convenient store received minor damage and several trees were uprooted when a F0 tornado briefly touched down at the intersection of FL 360 and Interstate 10.

ncei:5603772.title: Hesperia, California
ncei:5603772.narrative: A cold upper low primed the atmosphere for widespread thunderstorm activity over the mountains and deserts during the afternoon and evening hours.  One storm spawned a small tornado in Hesperia that overturned and destroyed a 300 pound fountain.

ncei:10324027.title: Muscatine, Iowa
ncei:10324027.narrative: Numerous small and brief tornadoes touched down west of Muscatine at this time.  Some vehicles were damaged by hail, but no damage was caused by the tornadoes.

ncei:10326548.title: Halstead, Kansas
ncei:10326548.narrative: Brief tornado touched down on Harvey and Sedgwick County lines.

ncei:10330204.title: Flora, Mississippi
ncei:10330204.narrative: Numerous trees were twisted off or blown down.  One house had minor roof damage.

ncei:10348173.title: Burnet, Texas
ncei:10348173.narrative: Small tornado touched down briefly, causing minor building damage.

ncei:10351088.title: Rochester, Texas
ncei:10351088.narrative: A brief tornado touchdown was reported.

ncei:10357103.title: Rock River, Wyoming
ncei:10357103.narrative: A brief tornado touched down in Albany County 22 miles east of Rock River.  Rock River is located 35 northwest of Laramie.

ncei:10318719.title: Cheraw, Colorado
ncei:10318719.narrative: Severe thunderstorms spawned three short-lived tornadoes in Crowley County; one south of Sugar City (18 miles of La Junta) and the other two near Cheraw (eight miles north of La Junta).  All of the tornadoes touched down in open fields, with no damage or injuries reported.

ncei:10319032.title: Commerce, Georgia
ncei:10319032.narrative: A short lived and weak tornado touched down along U.S. Highway 441 and downed several pine trees and power lines before  dissipating.

ncei:10319291.title: Lake Bird, Florida
ncei:10319291.narrative: A tornado snapped numerous pine and hardwood trees as it crossed Highway 221  and adjacent railroad tracks.

ncei:10328760.title: Eva, Louisiana
ncei:10328760.narrative: A severe thunderstorm moving through east-central Louisiana produced two tornadoes.  In Mayna, the damage was primarily to trees and power lines.  A tornado overturned a mobile home in Eva, resulting in two injuries.  In addition, the tornado destroyed two utility barns and damaged the roof of a house.

ncei:10348009.title: Beeville, Texas
ncei:10348009.narrative: A tornado touched down just southwest of the Beeville airport, destroying a large hangar.  The tornado also destroyed five mobile homes near the airport, then lifted and dissipated.  Power was reported out in the area as well.

ncei:10331373.title: Marshall, Minnesota
ncei:10331373.narrative: A tornado traveled along an intermittent path to the south and east of Marshall damaging a few farm buildings and uprooting several trees.

ncei:10354552.title: Mclennan, Texas
ncei:10354552.narrative: to 2 NE Lacy-   Lakeview,A tornado touched down just southeast of the intersection of highway 340 and Farm-to-Market Road 2491, moving nearly due north to the Texas State Technical Institute before lifting.  In addition to moving parked aircraft, a building's roof was lifted.
